name: Fiddlesticks
title: the Ancient Fear

Q.name: Terrify
Q.description: Passive: While unseen and out of combat or impersonating an Effigy, damaging an enemy with an ability Fears them for (varies) second(s). Active: Fear an enemy for (varies) second(s) and deal (varies) current Health magic damage. If the target has recently been Feared by Fiddlesticks, instead deal (varies) current Health magic damage.
Q.summary: Fiddlesticks damaging enemies with spells while unseen or targeting an enemy with Terrify's activation strikes a target unit with fear, causing it to flee in terror for a duration.

W.name: Bountiful Harvest
W.description: Fiddlesticks channels and drains the souls of nearby enemies, dealing (varies) magic damage per second for 2 seconds, plus (varies)% missing Health magic damage at the end. Fiddlesticks restores (varies)% of damage as Health. If Fiddlesticks ends the channel without interruption, the remaining Cooldown is reduced by 60%.
W.summary: Fiddlesticks drains health from nearby enemies, dealing bonus execute damage at the end of the duration.

E.name: Reap
E.description: Fiddlesticks unleashes dark magic, dealing (varies) magic damage and Slowing by (varies)% for (varies) seconds. Enemies in the center are also Silenced for the duration.
E.summary: Fiddlesticks slashes an area with its scythe, slowing all enemies hit and silencing enemies hit in the center of the slash.

R.name: Crowstorm
R.description: Fiddlesticks channels for (varies) seconds, then teleports and unleashes a murder of crows, dealing (varies) magic damage over (varies) seconds.
R.summary: A murder of crows flock wildly around Fiddlesticks, dealing damage per second to all enemy units in the area.

Passive.name: A Harmless Scarecrow
Passive.description: Fiddlesticks' trinket is replaced by scarecrow effigies.
Passive.summary: Fiddlesticks' trinket is replaced by scarecrow effigies.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Ambush jungler (also a support) who hides in fog and impersonates his Effigies. Wins fights by channelling R into a grouped team, then fearing and draining whoever is left.
strengths: R teleports after a channel and deals heavy area damage to a grouped team
Q fears a target; while he's unseen, any ability damage fears too
E slows, and silences enemies in the center
W drains nearby enemies with missing-health damage and heals him; finishing the channel cuts its cooldown by 60%
Effigies replace his trinket and confuse enemy vision
weaknesses: No dash: R is his only gap-closer and it has a visible channel that crowd control can interrupt
W is a channel that crowd control and movement break
Very dependent on getting to fog unseen before fights

curve.lvl1: weak – slow clear, no fear yet
curve.lvl3: medium – Q fear + E silence for ganks

profile.curveNote: Ganks need Q fear and E silence; before 3 he only farms with W. R at 6 is his real spike.
profile.waveClear: good – W drain on camps, E on waves
profile.sustain: high – W heals from damage dealt

Passive.notes: Trinket replaced by Effigies that act as wards and decoys.

Q.notes: Targeted fear plus % current-health damage; passive fear when unseen. Blocked by spell shields.

W.notes: 2 s channel drain; heals; interrupted by crowd control.

E.notes: Area slow; center is also silenced.

R.notes: Channel, then blink and crows over several seconds. Channel can be interrupted.

profile.windowAgainst: R on cooldown (100+ s), or caught in vision without Q: he has no escape.
checks: Q fear duration and R channel time show as (varies) in the file.
